---
title: About BioReport
---

**BioReport** is a modular, configurable report engine built with Python and Quarto, and a delivery component of **CygnusX BioOps**. It turns existing omics outputs into structured, interactive and verifiable research reports.

## Mission and Capabilities

Configuration controls module selection, parameters and delivery formats. Domain modules supply QC, expression, differential analysis and enrichment. Interactive Plotly charts and searchable tables support review; dedicated PDF templates support archiving. Optional AI interpretations require scientific review against the underlying evidence.

## Technical Architecture

Python handles validation, data paths, module composition and execution. pandas and NumPy process result tables; Plotly and ITables provide visualization. Quarto and Typst render the final documents. Local Python/Quarto or Docker can run report generation.

## CygnusX Research Ecosystem

- [GeoMuse](https://github.com/xsx123123/GeoMuse): public omics data and literature discovery.
- [Polariseq](https://github.com/xsx123123/polariseq): sequencing-data acquisition and transfer.
- [FlowFrame](https://github.com/xsx123123/FlowFrame): versioned bioinformatics workflows.
- [BioReport](https://github.com/xsx123123/bioreport): analysis organization and scientific report delivery.
- [CygnusX BioOps](https://github.com/xsx123123/OmicHub_BioOps): research agents, workflow orchestration and evidence tracking.

## Development and Acknowledgments

The project develops additional omics modules, provenance integration and evidence-grounded interpretation. Contributions and issues are welcome on [GitHub](https://github.com/xsx123123/bioreport). We thank participating research teams at Huazhong Agricultural University for their support with use cases and testing.

Maintained by the BioReport / CygnusX BioOps team.
